tranches.title: Immutable Work-Group Registry
tranches.objective: Account for every discovered era, planning group, work-state family, work item, non-work-state group, PDCP reduction and Project Source lineage without silent identity mutation.

tranches.title: Feature / Family / Wider-App Dependency Map
tranches.objective: Give every discovered work item a structural path to the wider app and record evidence-backed consumer/convergence dependencies separately from mere lineage.

tranches.title: Integrity Validation & Mutation Guard
tranches.objective: Validate exact coverage, explicit standalone lineage, child-gap ownership and mutation rules; only then release the PCV preimplementation series to continue.

completion_rule: All three tranches complete_verified; no unowned/unmapped discovered work identity; project-integrity validator and updated archaeology validator pass on exact candidate.
